# Overview

This package was built to allow easy access to data from the Eastern Australian Waterbird Survey, and the Murray-Darling Basin Wetland Survey, and some basic analysis of trends in these data. This vignette covers two main functions of `eawsAnalysis`:

- Extraction of waterbird data for downstream analysis (using `get_bird_data()`)

- Analysis of trends in waterbird data (using `clean_data_run_models()`)

# Installation

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| eval: false
#| 
# This package can be installed from Github
pak::pkg_install("will02-code/eawsAnalysis")
# or 
# remotes::install_github("will02-code/eawsAnalysis")


```

# Getting started

```{r}
# Load the package
library(eawsAnalysis)
# The package comes with data built in; load it
data("data_clean")


```
